from pathlib import Path
path=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-low-rnd0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u031/system/state/workspace/programs/task-55257829.py')
code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    color = next(v for row in grid for v in row if v != 0)
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        marks = [c for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == color]
        for left, right in zip(marks, marks[1:]):
            for c in range(left + 1, right):
                out[r][c] = 2
    return out
'''
